title: 2.1 Where people go
unit_title: Places, things and how we describe them
unit_outcome: Say where people go and how they get there, talk about the things people have, point things out and compare them, put things in order, and ask about favorites.
goal: Say where people go with go to and goes to (I go to the gym. / Luis goes to the gym.), with three new places: gym, pool and office.
grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 2.1 Places Around Me: A1 names places (It is a park.) and says what people are doing in them (The girl is running in the park.); A1+ 2.1 says where people go. The one new grammar relationship is go to + place with he/she goes, the -es spelling of go, taught against the I-form (I go to the gym. / Luis goes to the gym.) and heard against A1's is going (Luis is going to the gym.). New places: gym, pool, office.
prerequisite: A1 2.1 places (park) and It is a/an; A1 4.6 go to school; A1 6.3 I am going to; A1 6.11 goes; A1+ 1.2-1.3 the he/she -s; A1+ 1.9 Where does…?; A1+ 1.3 Ana swims and Sofia runs in the park.
speaking_outcome: Say goes with a long o and a final z sound (/ɡoʊz/), different from go; keep to the in go to the gym short. Do not require native-like speed.
